monday.label: Push (Chest / Shoulders / Triceps)
monday.warmup: Treadmill incline walk 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + DB front raise 5 lbs × 10 + ramp-up sets of incline press at 35 ea × 8 then 50 ea × 4
monday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side + overhead triceps stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: Last 50 ea 15/12/12 on 10/6 (W36: 60 ea 12/11/7 on 8/30). Back to 60; re-own 10×3 first — set 3 fell apart last time. Deep stretch at the bottom; 12/12/12 → 65
Last 50 ea 12×3 on 10/6 (W36: 60 ea 12/10/9). Re-own 10×3. No spotter: rack the DBs before anything grinds
Last 25 15×3 on 10/6 (W36: 30 10/9/9). Lock 10×3 at 30 before targeting 12. Lengthened partials are back on the last set
Last 45 ea 14/12/11 on 10/6 and 15/15/13 on 10/9 (W36: 50 ea 10×3 on 8/30, 12/12/11 on 9/2; 55 banked). Strict; 12/12/12 at 50 this week spends the 55 in W43
Last 15 ea 15/12/15 on 10/6 (W36: 20 ea 10×3 on 8/30, locked). Reps climb to 12 at 20; strict, no swing
Last 45 15/15/10 on 10/6 (W36: 55 12/11/12). Finish set 2; 12/12/12 → 60. Seated with back support

tuesday.label: Pull (Back / Biceps / Rear Delts)
tuesday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + scap pull-ups × 10 + ramp-up sets of lat pulldown at 90 × 8 then 115 × 4
tuesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body rear-delt stretch 60s ea side + gentle forearm stretch 45s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: W41 on record at 115 10×3 (10/7); W36: 130 10×3 on 8/31 after 12/9/9 on 8/25. Re-own 10×3 at 130 — the 8/25 miss is why this is not 12 yet. Chest up, full stretch at the top, no lean-back
W41 115 10×3; W36: 130 12×3 (135 banked). Show 12/12/12 again at 130 and the 135 lands in W43. Pause at the chest
W41 55 ea 10×3 (10/7) and 50 ea 12×3 (10/9); W36: 65 ea 12×3 (70 banked). Re-prove 12×3 → 70 in W43. LEFT first; right matches left's reps; no torso heave
W41 50 12×3 both days; W36: 60 15×3 (65 banked). Re-prove 15×3 → 65 in W43. Rope to the ears, strict
W41 15 ea 12×3; W36: 20 ea 15×3 (25 banked). Re-prove 15×3 → 25 in W43. Strict, soft elbows
W41 50 10×3; W36: 60 10×3 (11/9/8 on 8/25 before that). Lock 10×3 at 60 before targeting 12; fixed bars step by 10, so the gate earns 70. No hip swing
W41 25 ea 10×3; W36: 30 ea 10×3 (10/9/9 on 8/25 before that). Lock 10×3 before targeting 12. Elbows still
W41 65 ea 20 s × 3; W36: 75 ea 25 s × 3. Hold 25 s each side, LEFT hand first; 30 s × 3 is the gate for 80. Tall, no lean, keep breathing

wednesday.label: Legs (Quads / Hams / Glutes / Calves / Core)
wednesday.warmup: Easy treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + ramp-up sets: squat bar × 8, 95 × 5, 115 × 3; leg press 180 × 8 then 250 × 5. Pain rule: left groin/adductor 0–2/10 or modify
wednesday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle standing quad stretch 45s ea side + gentle hamstring stretch 45s ea side + calf stretch 45s ea side. No wide-stance or aggressive adductor stretching. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free

exercises.notes: Last 110×12, 130×10, 130×10 on 10/8 — you went past the 115 target on your own; W36: 140 10×3 on 9/1. The hip-protective 140 is the load; 150 waits for 12/12/12. Pain-free depth, light brace, exhale on the drive
Last 280 10/10/15 on 10/8; W36: 320 10/10/11 on 9/1 (first set was 270). All three at 320 this time (45+45+45+25 per side). Feet hip-width; do not bottom out
Last 110 10×3 on 10/8 (plan said 100×8); W36: 120 10/10/9. Finish set 3; 12/12/12 → 125. Controlled eccentric, double-overhand
Last 75 12×3 on 10/8; W36: 85 12/12/10. Finish set 3; 12/12/12 → 90. Full range, pause at the bottom
Last 100 10×3 on 10/8; W36: 110 10/10/9. Lock 10×3 before targeting 12. Chin tucked; sit up 20–30 s before standing
Last 220 12×3 on 10/8; W36: 260 15/15/14. One rep finishes the 15×3 gate → 270. Full range, 1 s pause, no bounce
Last 50 12×3 on 10/8; W36: 60 10×3 (locked). Reps climb to 12 at 60; exhale into the crunch
Last 25-lb plate 12×3 on 10/8; W36: 25 12×3 (locked). Reps climb to 15; 15×3 → 35. Smooth, no hyperextension

thursday.label: Upper Hybrid (Shoulders / Chest / Back / Arms / Core)
thursday.warmup: Rower 5 min easy + scap circles + band pull-aparts × 15 × 2 + ramp-up sets of shoulder press at 30 ea × 8 then 40 ea × 4
thursday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + doorway pec stretch 60s ea side + child's pose with side reach 60s ea side + cross-body shoulder stretch 60s ea side. 16 oz electrolyte water

exercises.notes: Last 45 ea 15/15/13 on 10/9; W36: 50 ea 12/12/11 on 9/2 (55 banked). One rep finishes the lock; with Monday's 12/12/12 too, 55 lands in W43. Strict
Last 45 ea 15/12/10 on 10/9; W36: 55 ea 11/12/11 on 9/2. Second incline exposure this week, 5 lighter than Monday; 12/12/12 → 60
Last 15 ea 15/15/12 on 10/9; W36: 15 ea 16/15/15 on 9/2. Strict 15×3 at 15 → 20 in this slot. No swing
Last 50 12×3 on 10/9; W36: 60 15×3 (65 banked). Same as Tuesday; rope to the ears
Last 50 ea 12×3 on 10/9; W36: 60 ea 10×3 on 9/2 (locked). Reps climb to 12 at 60. LEFT first; right matches left's reps
Last 20 ea 10×3 on 10/9; W36: 25 ea 12/12/11 on 9/2. One rep finishes the lock → 30. No swing
Last 30 10/8/8 on 10/9; W36: 35 9/9/7 on 9/2. Lock 8×3 at 35 before targeting 10. Elbows still, no bounce at the bottom
Last 45 12×3 on 10/9; W36: 50 10×3 on 9/2 (locked). Reps climb to 12 at 50. LEFT side first; exhale on the press-out, no twist
Last 40 s × 3 on 10/9; W36: 60 s × 3. Back to 60 s each side, LEFT first; if the hips drop before 60, stop the set there and log the honest time

friday.label: Lower Hybrid (Glutes / Quads / Hams / Calves / Core)
friday.warmup: Easy bike or treadmill 5–8 min + controlled bodyweight squats × 10 + glute bridges × 10 + gentle reverse lunges only if pain-free + ramp-up set on the single-leg press (70 lbs × 6 each leg, left first). No wide hip openers
friday.cooldown: Easy walk 5 min + gentle quad, hamstring, and calf stretches 45s ea side. No wide-leg, straddle, 90/90, or figure-4 positions. 16 oz electrolyte water. Thermocycling tonight if the session was flag-free

exercises.notes: W41 target was 100 12×3 (Sat 10/10 not in the log); W36: 115 12×3 on 9/4. Hold the protective 115 at 12×3 — not a load test. LEFT first; right matches left's reps; pain-free depth

W41 target 20 ea 10/leg; W36: 25 ea 15×3 on 9/4 (30 banked). Re-prove 15×3 → 30 in W43. First full-volume lunge since September — expect DOMS, not a reason to cut. LEFT leg steps first; hip-width tracks
W41 target 65 12×3; W36: 75 15×3 on 9/4 (80 banked). Re-prove 15×3 → 80 in W43. Full range, pause at the bottom
W41 target 80 12×3; W36: 90 15×3 on 9/4. Hold the protective 90 at 15×3; symptom-free middle range, controlled
W40 probe 40 12×2 on 10/2 was quiet; W41 planned 45 12×3 (not in the log). W36 never ran this, so the W41 45 holds. Pads narrow, middle range only; 15×3 → 50
W41 target 40 ea 12×3; W36: 50 ea 13/12/12 on 9/4 (locked 12). Reps climb to 15; 15×3 → 55. LEFT first; right matches; full range, 1 s pause
W41 target 45 12×3; W36: 55 15/12/12 on 9/4 (locked 12). Reps climb to 15; 15×3 → 60. Exhale into the crunch
Same plate as Wednesday; W36: 25 15/12/12 on 9/4. 15×3 → 35. Smooth; come up slowly
